title: New User Provisioning
overview: Provisions new user accounts with proper group memberships, license assignments, Conditional Access targeting, and Intune pre-assignment.

title: User Offboarding -- Disable
overview: Disables user account, revokes sign-in sessions, converts mailbox to shared, and applies litigation hold.

title: User Offboarding -- Hard Delete
overview: Permanently removes user account, reclaims licenses, archives mailbox. Requires Tier 3 separation of duties approval.

title: Role Change / Transfer
overview: Audits group memberships, reassigns PIM roles, updates Conditional Access and Intune targeting.

title: Leave of Absence -- Suspend
overview: Disables account without license removal, adds to LOA security group, preserves memberships.

title: LOA Return -- Restore
overview: Re-enables account, restores PIM roles, forces MFA re-registration.

title: MFA Enrollment Enforcement
overview: Enforces MFA enrollment via Conditional Access policy and Authentication Methods Policy. Requires phishing-resistant methods.

title: MFA Method Audit -- Weak Removal
overview: Audits registered MFA methods and removes weak methods (SMS/voice).

title: Privileged Role Review (PIM)
overview: Quarterly Access Review on privileged roles with auto-remove for stale assignments.

title: Standing Privilege Elimination
overview: Converts a permanent (standing) Global Administrator assignment to a PIM-eligible assignment: creates JIT eligibility for the principal, then removes the standing active assignment. Remediates AC.L2-3.1.5.

parameters.name: targetUPN
parameters.label: Admin UPN to convert to PIM-eligible

title: Default User Permission Lockdown
overview: Restricts default (non-admin) user permissions: blocks app registration, security-group creation, and tenant creation. Remediates AC.L2-3.1.2 (transaction/function control).

title: Break-Glass Conditional Access Exclusion
overview: Excludes the emergency-access (break-glass) account from a blocking Conditional Access policy so an MFA/grant-control outage cannot lock out emergency access, while the policy stays enforced for all other users. Idempotent - no-op if the account is already excluded. Remediates the CA-02 exclusion finding (AC.L2-3.1.7 emergency-access resilience).

parameters.name: policyDisplayName
parameters.label: CA policy to exclude the break-glass account from

title: Conditional Access Duplicate Policy Cleanup
overview: Deletes duplicate Conditional Access policies that share one displayName, keeping the oldest copy. Only report-only/disabled duplicates are deleted - an ENABLED duplicate is never deleted automatically (it is surfaced for manual review) so enforcement cannot change. Remediates CA-policy config drift such as a provisioning re-run loop creating dozens of copies of the same policy. Baseline hygiene for CM.L2-3.4.1/3.4.2.

parameters.name: policyDisplayName
parameters.label: Duplicated CA policy displayName to dedupe

title: Device Compliance Baseline Enforcement
overview: Creates a Windows 10/11 device compliance policy (BitLocker, secure boot, min OS) so the compliant-device Conditional Access gate has a baseline to evaluate. Remediates CM.L2-3.4.2.

title: Autopilot Profile Provisioning
overview: Creates a Windows Autopilot deployment profile so new devices are provisioned to a controlled baseline at enrollment. Remediates CM.L2-3.4.1 (baseline configuration).

title: Stale Account Detection
overview: Filters accounts by signInActivity, disables accounts with no sign-in >90 days, deletes >180 days.

title: Guest / External User Audit
overview: Guest user inventory with Access Review and B2B cross-tenant policy enforcement.

title: CA Policy Review
overview: Exports all Conditional Access policies and performs gap analysis against CMMC AC/SC requirements.

title: Named Location Update
overview: Updates trusted IP ranges and geo-blocking configurations for Conditional Access.

title: Break-Glass Validation
overview: Monthly test sign-in, Sentinel alert verification, CA/PIM exclusion validation.

title: Suspicious Sign-In Response
overview: Confirms risky user compromise, revokes sessions, escalates to H-02 for containment.

title: Admin Account Separation
overview: Creates cloud-only admin accounts with no mailbox and PIM-only role assignments.

title: New Device Enrollment
overview: Enrolls device via Autopilot, applies compliance policy, security baseline, and BitLocker XTS-AES 256.

title: Compliance Policy Gap Report
overview: Generates device inventory pivot by compliance policy status.

title: OS Patch Currency Audit
overview: OS version inventory, comparison against MSRC, expedited critical patch deployment.

title: Security Baseline Drift

title: Terminated-User Device Wipe

title: Lost/Stolen Device Wipe

title: Non-Compliant Device CA Block
overview: Conditional Access policy requiring compliant device status with grace period.

title: BYOD Separation (MAM)

title: Autopilot Profile Review

title: App Secret Rotation
overview: Rotates application secrets with Key Vault integration.

title: Key Vault RBAC Audit

title: TLS/SSL Certificate Expiry

title: Service Account Password Rotation

title: Orphaned App/SPN Cleanup

title: Password Policy Compliance

title: Leaked Credential Response

overview: 9-item intake checklist for new CUI repositories.

title: CUI Label Protection Enablement
overview: Enables encryption (rights-based access limited to the CUI-authorized group) and automatic content marking (header/footer/watermark) on the published CUI sensitivity label. Converts MP.L2-3.8.2 (label-based access to CUI media) and MP.L2-3.8.4 (CUI markings) from attested to directly enforced (remediates FINDING F-LABEL). Get-then-set via the Security & Compliance PS (IPPS) channel; idempotent.

title: Audit Log Retention
overview: Configures retention policies, WORM storage, and Sentinel retention.

title: Unified Audit Log Health
overview: Verifies events are flowing, detects gaps, validates Sentinel heartbeat.

overview: Reviews rule inventory with MITRE mapping and effectiveness metrics.

overview: Calculates false positive rate and tunes rules with automation rules.

overview: Runs ScubaGear (CISA) or CIS-CAT for benchmark compliance.

overview: Permission inventory with high-risk permission detection.

title: Azure Firewall Deallocate
overview: Deallocates the fw-cmmc Azure Firewall Premium — strips IP configurations to stop billing while preserving rule configuration. Network egress filtering stops until re-allocated. Run only during approved maintenance windows.

title: Azure Firewall Allocate
overview: Allocates (restarts) the fw-cmmc Azure Firewall Premium — re-attaches VNET and public IP to restore network traffic filtering. Required after a deallocate maintenance window.

title: Enclave Subnet Deny-by-Default Baseline
overview: Applies the no-firewall boundary posture to every non-platform subnet of a VNet (G-FW-ALT Phase 1): ensures each subnet has an NSG (creates one if missing) carrying Allow-VNet in/out at priority 4000 and explicit Deny-All in/out at 4096, associates a 0.0.0.0/0 -> None blackhole route table, and enables privateEndpointNetworkPolicies so NSG rules evaluate on Private Endpoint traffic. Idempotent - existing rules/associations are left in place. Remediates UC-H findings F-NET-1/2/3 (SC.L2-3.13.1[e][f][h], SC.L2-3.13.6[a][b]).

title: VNet Flow Logs + Sentinel Flow Analytics
overview: Enables VNet flow logs (NSG flow log creation retired Jun 2025) on a VNet with Traffic Analytics into the Log Analytics workspace, and creates a Sentinel scheduled analytics rule over NTANetAnalytics for denied/anomalous flows. Idempotent - skips whatever already exists. Remediates UC-H finding F-NET-4 (SC.L2-3.13.1[c][d][g], SI.L2-3.14.6[a][b][c]). Incremental cost ~$10-40/mo ingestion.
